platform_business_report.src:
declare
  v_from timestamptz := (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Dhaka');
  v_to timestamptz := ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Dhaka');
  v_assume jsonb := public._platform_cost_assumptions();
  v_real uuid[];
  v_paid jsonb;
  v_revenue numeric;
  v_sms jsonb;
  v_bd jsonb;
  v_costs jsonb;
  v_recorded numeric;
  v_known_provider numeric;
  v_estimated numeric;
  v_fee numeric;
  v_missing text[] := '{}';
  v_assumptions text[] := '{}';
  v_paying_start int;
  v_churned int;
  v_pbx numeric;
begin
  perform public._platform_require('subscriptions', 'view');
  if p_to < p_from or p_to - p_from > 731 then
    raise exception 'VALIDATION: choose a range of up to two years' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  -- Real merchants only: demo and test merchants are left out of every business figure.
  select coalesce(array_agg(id), '{}') into v_real from public.merchants where not is_demo and id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids());

  -- Money actually received (verified payments), by what it paid for.
  select jsonb_build_object(
      'total', coalesce(sum(p.amount), 0),
      'subscriptions', coalesce(sum(p.amount) filter (where i.kind = 'SUBSCRIPTION'), 0),
      'credits', coalesce(sum(p.amount) filter (where i.kind = 'CREDITS'), 0),
      'addons', coalesce(sum(p.amount) filter (where i.kind = 'ADDON'), 0),
      'other', coalesce(sum(p.amount) filter (where i.kind = 'OTHER'), 0),
      'payments', count(*))
    into v_paid
  from public.billing_payments p join public.billing_invoices i on i.id = p.invoice_id
  where p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) >= v_from and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) < v_to
    and p.merchant_id = any (v_real);
  -- VoiceDrive packages and call top-ups, paid to the platform with bKash.
  v_pbx := (select coalesce(sum(t.amount_tk), 0) from public.pbx_bkash_transactions t
            where t.status = 'COMPLETED' and t.completed_at >= v_from and t.completed_at < v_to and t.merchant_id = any (v_real));
  v_paid := v_paid || jsonb_build_object('pbx', v_pbx, 'total', (v_paid ->> 'total')::numeric + v_pbx);
  v_revenue := (v_paid ->> 'total')::numeric;

  -- SMS: credit sales vs what sending cost.
  select jsonb_build_object(
      'credit_sales', coalesce((select sum((l ->> 'amount')::numeric) from public.billing_invoices i, jsonb_array_elements(i.lines) l
                               where i.kind = 'CREDITS' and i.status = 'PAID' and i.paid_at >= v_from and i.paid_at < v_to and i.merchant_id = any (v_real)
                                 and l ->> 'kind' = 'credits' and l ->> 'credit_type' = 'SMS'), 0),
      'units', coalesce(sum(u.units) filter (where u.status = 'SUCCEEDED' and u.refunded_at is null), 0),
      'free_units', coalesce(sum(u.units) filter (where u.status = 'SUCCEEDED' and u.refunded_at is null and u.charge = 'FREE'), 0),
      'credits_used', coalesce(sum(u.credits) filter (where u.charge = 'CREDITS' and u.refunded_at is null and u.status <> 'DENIED'), 0),
      'provider_cost_reported', coalesce(sum(u.provider_cost), 0),
      'units_without_cost', coalesce(sum(u.units) filter (where u.status = 'SUCCEEDED' and u.provider_cost is null), 0))
    into v_sms
  from public.service_usage u
  where u.service = 'SMS' and u.created_at >= v_from and u.created_at < v_to and u.merchant_id = any (v_real);
  v_sms := v_sms || jsonb_build_object('provider_cost_estimated',
    case when (v_sms ->> 'units_without_cost')::numeric = 0 then 0
         when v_assume ->> 'sms_per_part' is null then null
         else round((v_sms ->> 'units_without_cost')::numeric * (v_assume ->> 'sms_per_part')::numeric, 2) end);

  select jsonb_build_object(
      'credit_sales', coalesce((select sum((l ->> 'amount')::numeric) from public.billing_invoices i, jsonb_array_elements(i.lines) l
                               where i.kind = 'CREDITS' and i.status = 'PAID' and i.paid_at >= v_from and i.paid_at < v_to and i.merchant_id = any (v_real)
                                 and l ->> 'kind' = 'credits' and l ->> 'credit_type' = 'COURIER'), 0),
      'lookups', count(*) filter (where u.status = 'SUCCEEDED'),
      'free_lookups', count(*) filter (where u.status = 'SUCCEEDED' and u.charge = 'FREE'),
      'failed', count(*) filter (where u.status = 'FAILED'),
      'credits_used', coalesce(sum(u.credits) filter (where u.charge = 'CREDITS' and u.refunded_at is null and u.status <> 'DENIED'), 0))
    into v_bd
  from public.service_usage u
  where u.service = 'BD_COURIER' and u.created_at >= v_from and u.created_at < v_to and u.merchant_id = any (v_real);
  v_bd := v_bd || jsonb_build_object('cost_estimated',
    case when (v_bd ->> 'lookups')::int = 0 then 0
         when v_assume ->> 'bd_courier_per_lookup' is null then null
         else round((v_bd ->> 'lookups')::numeric * (v_assume ->> 'bd_courier_per_lookup')::numeric, 2) end);

  -- Costs the company recorded for the months in the range (actual).
  select jsonb_build_object(
      'by_category', coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(category, total) from (select category, sum(amount) as total from public.platform_cost_entries
                               where month >= date_trunc('month', p_from) and month <= p_to group by category) c), '{}'::jsonb),
      'total', coalesce((select sum(amount) from public.platform_cost_entries where month >= date_trunc('month', p_from) and month <= p_to), 0),
      'months_with_entries', (select count(distinct month) from public.platform_cost_entries where month >= date_trunc('month', p_from) and month <= p_to),
      'months_in_range', (select count(*) from generate_series(date_trunc('month', p_from), date_trunc('month', p_to::timestamp), interval '1 month')))
    into v_costs;
  v_recorded := (v_costs ->> 'total')::numeric;

  -- The SMS provider bill, if recorded, already contains what usage rows report: count one of them.
  if coalesce((v_costs #>> '{by_category,SMS_PROVIDER}')::numeric, 0) <> 0 then
    v_known_provider := 0;
    v_assumptions := array_append(v_assumptions, 'SMS provider cost is taken from the recorded provider bills, not from per-message costs');
  else
    v_known_provider := (v_sms ->> 'provider_cost_reported')::numeric;
    if (v_sms ->> 'units_without_cost')::numeric > 0 then
      if v_sms ->> 'provider_cost_estimated' is null then
        v_missing := array_append(v_missing, format('%s SMS parts have no reported cost and no cost per part is set (SMS Management)', v_sms ->> 'units_without_cost'));
      else
        v_assumptions := array_append(v_assumptions, format('SMS parts without a reported cost are estimated at %s BDT each', v_assume ->> 'sms_per_part'));
      end if;
    end if;
  end if;
  if coalesce((v_costs #>> '{by_category,COURIER_API}')::numeric, 0) = 0 and (v_bd ->> 'lookups')::int > 0 then
    if v_bd ->> 'cost_estimated' is null then
      v_missing := array_append(v_missing, format('%s BD Courier lookups have no cost per lookup set', v_bd ->> 'lookups'));
    else
      v_assumptions := array_append(v_assumptions, format('BD Courier lookups are estimated at %s BDT each', v_assume ->> 'bd_courier_per_lookup'));
    end if;
  end if;
  v_fee := case when v_assume ->> 'payment_fee_percent' is null or coalesce((v_costs #>> '{by_category,PAYMENT_FEES}')::numeric, 0) <> 0 then null
                else round(v_revenue * (v_assume ->> 'payment_fee_percent')::numeric / 100, 2) end;
  if v_fee is not null then
    v_assumptions := array_append(v_assumptions, format('Payment gateway fees estimated at %s%% of money received', v_assume ->> 'payment_fee_percent'));
  elsif coalesce((v_costs #>> '{by_category,PAYMENT_FEES}')::numeric, 0) = 0 and v_revenue > 0 then
    v_missing := array_append(v_missing, 'Payment gateway fees: not recorded and no fee percent set');
  end if;
  if (v_costs ->> 'months_with_entries')::int < (v_costs ->> 'months_in_range')::int then
    v_missing := array_append(v_missing, format('Recorded costs cover %s of %s months in the range (hosting, staff tools and other bills)',
      v_costs ->> 'months_with_entries', v_costs ->> 'months_in_range'));
  end if;
  v_estimated := coalesce((case when coalesce((v_costs #>> '{by_category,SMS_PROVIDER}')::numeric, 0) <> 0 then 0 else (v_sms ->> 'provider_cost_estimated')::numeric end), 0)
               + coalesce((case when coalesce((v_costs #>> '{by_category,COURIER_API}')::numeric, 0) <> 0 then 0 else (v_bd ->> 'cost_estimated')::numeric end), 0)
               + coalesce(v_fee, 0);
  v_assumptions := array_append(v_assumptions, 'Revenue is money received and verified in the range; credits bought are counted when paid, not when used');

  -- Churn: paying subscriptions at the start of the range that ended in it.
  select count(*) into v_paying_start from public.subscriptions s
  where s.merchant_id = any (v_real) and s.price > 0 and s.started_at < v_from and (s.ended_at is null or s.ended_at >= v_from)
    and coalesce(s.trial_ends_at, s.started_at) < v_from;
  select count(*) into v_churned from public.subscriptions s
  where s.merchant_id = any (v_real) and s.price > 0 and s.status in ('CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED') and s.ended_at >= v_from and s.ended_at < v_to;

  return jsonb_build_object(
    'range', jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to),
    'mrr', (select jsonb_build_object(
        'mrr', coalesce(sum(case s.billing_interval when 'YEAR' then s.price / 12 else s.price end) filter (where s.status in ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE')), 0),
        'arr', coalesce(sum(case s.billing_interval when 'YEAR' then s.price / 12 else s.price end) filter (where s.status in ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE')), 0) * 12,
        'at_risk', coalesce(sum(case s.billing_interval when 'YEAR' then s.price / 12 else s.price end) filter (where s.status = 'PAST_DUE' or s.cancel_at_period_end), 0),
        'trialing', coalesce(sum(case s.billing_interval when 'YEAR' then s.price / 12 else s.price end) filter (where s.status = 'TRIALING'), 0),
        'paying', count(*) filter (where s.status in ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE') and s.price > 0))
      from public.subscriptions s where s.ended_at is null and s.merchant_id = any (v_real)),
    'mrr_by_plan', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x.mrr desc), '[]'::jsonb) from (
        select pl.code, pl.name, count(*) filter (where s.status in ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE')) as active, count(*) filter (where s.status = 'TRIALING') as trialing,
               coalesce(sum(case s.billing_interval when 'YEAR' then s.price / 12 else s.price end) filter (where s.status in ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE')), 0) as mrr
        from public.subscriptions s join public.plans pl on pl.id = s.plan_id
        where s.ended_at is null and s.merchant_id = any (v_real) group by pl.code, pl.name) x),
    'revenue', v_paid || jsonb_build_object(
      'by_plan', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x.amount desc), '[]'::jsonb) from (
          select pl.code, pl.name, sum(p.amount) as amount from public.billing_payments p
          join public.billing_invoices i on i.id = p.invoice_id join public.subscriptions s on s.id = i.subscription_id join public.plans pl on pl.id = s.plan_id
          where p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' and i.kind = 'SUBSCRIPTION' and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) >= v_from and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) < v_to
            and p.merchant_id = any (v_real) group by pl.code, pl.name) x),
      'refunds', 0, 'refunds_note', 'The billing system has no refund flow; none are recorded'),
    'merchants', jsonb_build_object(
      'new', (select count(*) from public.merchants where id = any (v_real) and created_at >= v_from and created_at < v_to),
      'active', (select count(distinct o.merchant_id) from public.orders o where o.merchant_id = any (v_real) and o.created_at >= v_from and o.created_at < v_to),
      'total', coalesce(array_length(v_real, 1), 0)),
    'subscriptions', jsonb_build_object(
      'renewals', (select count(*) from public.billing_invoices i join public.subscriptions s on s.id = i.subscription_id
                   where i.kind = 'SUBSCRIPTION' and i.status = 'PAID' and i.paid_at >= v_from and i.paid_at < v_to and i.merchant_id = any (v_real)
                     and i.period_start > coalesce(s.trial_ends_at, s.started_at) + interval '1 day'),
      'cancelled', (select count(*) from public.subscription_events e where e.merchant_id = any (v_real) and e.event in ('subscription.cancel', 'subscription.cancelled')
                    and e.created_at >= v_from and e.created_at < v_to),
      'expired', (select count(*) from public.subscription_events e where e.merchant_id = any (v_real) and e.event = 'subscription.expired'
                  and e.created_at >= v_from and e.created_at < v_to),
      'paying_at_start', v_paying_start,
      'churned', v_churned,
      'churn_rate', case when v_paying_start > 0 then round(v_churned::numeric * 100 / v_paying_start, 1) end),
    'payments', jsonb_build_object(
      'failed', (select count(*) from public.billing_payments p where p.status in ('FAILED', 'REJECTED') and p.created_at >= v_from and p.created_at < v_to
                 and p.merchant_id = any (v_real)),
      'failed_amount', (select coalesce(sum(p.amount), 0) from public.billing_payments p where p.status in ('FAILED', 'REJECTED')
                        and p.created_at >= v_from and p.created_at < v_to and p.merchant_id = any (v_real)),
      'awaiting_verification', (select count(*) from public.billing_payments p where p.status = 'PENDING' and p.merchant_id = any (v_real)),
      'overdue_invoices', (select count(*) from public.billing_invoices i where i.status = 'OPEN' and i.due_at < now() and i.merchant_id = any (v_real)),
      'overdue_amount', (select coalesce(sum(i.total - i.amount_paid), 0) from public.billing_invoices i where i.status = 'OPEN' and i.due_at < now()
                         and i.merchant_id = any (v_real))),
    'sms', v_sms,
    'bd_courier', v_bd,
    'ai', jsonb_build_object('metered', false, 'note', 'No AI feature records usage yet, so there is nothing to report or charge'),
    'costs', v_costs || jsonb_build_object('provider_reported', v_known_provider, 'estimated', v_estimated, 'payment_fees_estimated', v_fee),
    'margin', jsonb_build_object(
      'revenue', v_revenue,
      'known_costs', v_recorded + v_known_provider,
      'estimated_costs', v_estimated,
      'contribution', v_revenue - v_recorded - v_known_provider - v_estimated,
      -- Only a complete picture gets a margin percent.
      'complete', cardinality(v_missing) = 0,
      'assumptions', to_jsonb(v_assumptions),
      'missing', to_jsonb(v_missing)),
    'by_merchant', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(x order by x.revenue desc, x.number), '[]'::jsonb) from (
        select m.id, m.number, m.name,
          coalesce((select sum(p.amount) from public.billing_payments p where p.merchant_id = m.id and p.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
                    and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) >= v_from and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) < v_to), 0)
          + coalesce((select sum(t.amount_tk) from public.pbx_bkash_transactions t where t.merchant_id = m.id and t.status = 'COMPLETED'
                    and t.completed_at >= v_from and t.completed_at < v_to), 0) as revenue,
          coalesce((select sum(coalesce(u.provider_cost, case when u.status = 'SUCCEEDED' then u.units * (v_assume ->> 'sms_per_part')::numeric end))
                    from public.service_usage u where u.merchant_id = m.id and u.service = 'SMS' and u.created_at >= v_from and u.created_at < v_to), 0) as sms_cost,
          (select count(*) from public.service_usage u where u.merchant_id = m.id and u.service = 'BD_COURIER' and u.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
             and u.created_at >= v_from and u.created_at < v_to) * (v_assume ->> 'bd_courier_per_lookup')::numeric as bd_cost,
          (select count(*) from public.service_usage u where u.merchant_id = m.id and u.service = 'BD_COURIER' and u.status = 'SUCCEEDED'
             and u.created_at >= v_from and u.created_at < v_to) as bd_lookups
        from public.merchants m where m.id = any (v_real)) x
      where x.revenue > 0 or x.sms_cost > 0 or x.bd_lookups > 0),
    'monthly', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('month', mo::date,
        'subscriptions', (select coalesce(sum(p.amount), 0) from public.billing_payments p join public.billing_invoices i on i.id = p.invoice_id
                          where p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' and i.kind = 'SUBSCRIPTION' and p.merchant_id = any (v_real)
                            and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) >= mo and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) < mo + interval '1 month'),
        'credits', (select coalesce(sum(p.amount), 0) from public.billing_payments p join public.billing_invoices i on i.id = p.invoice_id
                    where p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' and i.kind <> 'SUBSCRIPTION' and p.merchant_id = any (v_real)
                      and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) >= mo and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) < mo + interval '1 month')
                 + (select coalesce(sum(t.amount_tk), 0) from public.pbx_bkash_transactions t where t.status = 'COMPLETED' and t.merchant_id = any (v_real)
                      and t.completed_at >= mo and t.completed_at < mo + interval '1 month'),
        'costs', (select coalesce(sum(amount), 0) from public.platform_cost_entries where month = mo::date),
        'new_merchants', (select count(*) from public.merchants where id = any (v_real) and created_at >= mo and created_at < mo + interval '1 month'),
        'churned', (select count(*) from public.subscriptions s where s.merchant_id = any (v_real) and s.price > 0 and s.status in ('CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')
                    and s.ended_at >= mo and s.ended_at < mo + interval '1 month')) order by mo), '[]'::jsonb)
      from generate_series(date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '11 months', date_trunc('month', now()), interval '1 month') mo),
    'assumptions', v_assume);
end;

platform_can.src:
select exists (
    select 1
    from public.platform_staff s
    join public.platform_roles r on r.id = s.role_id
    where s.user_id = auth.uid()
      and s.is_active
      and coalesce(auth.jwt() ->> 'role', '') = 'authenticated'
      and (r.is_super or exists (select 1 from public.platform_role_permissions rp
                                 where rp.role_id = r.id and rp.module = p_module and rp.action = p_action))
      and (p_merchant is null or r.is_super or s.merchant_scope = 'ALL'
           or exists (select 1 from public.platform_staff_merchants sm where sm.user_id = s.user_id and sm.merchant_id = p_merchant))
  ) and public._platform_session_ok()

platform_credits_overview.src:
declare
  v_q text := nullif(trim(coalesce(p_q, '')), '');
begin
  perform public._platform_require('credits', 'view');
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'types', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code', t.code, 'name', t.name, 'unit', t.unit, 'description', t.description, 'used_by', t.used_by,
        'outstanding', (select coalesce(sum(b.balance), 0) from public.credit_balances b where b.credit_type = t.code and b.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())),
        'merchants_with_balance', (select count(*) from public.credit_balances b where b.credit_type = t.code and b.balance > 0 and b.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())),
        'added_30d', (select coalesce(sum(l.amount), 0) from public.credit_ledger l where l.credit_type = t.code and l.amount > 0 and l.kind <> 'REFUND'
                      and l.created_at > now() - interval '30 days' and l.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())),
        'used_30d', (select coalesce(-sum(l.amount), 0) from public.credit_ledger l where l.credit_type = t.code and l.kind in ('USAGE', 'REFUND')
                     and l.created_at > now() - interval '30 days' and l.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())))
      order by t.sort_order) from public.credit_types t), '[]'::jsonb),
    'merchants', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x order by x.number) from (
      select m.id, m.number, m.name, m.status,
             jsonb_object_agg(b.credit_type, b.balance) filter (where b.credit_type is not null) as balances
      from public.merchants m left join public.credit_balances b on b.merchant_id = m.id and (p_type is null or b.credit_type = p_type)
      where m.id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())
        and (v_q is null or m.name ilike '%' || v_q || '%' or m.number::text = v_q)
      group by m.id order by m.number limit greatest(1, least(p_limit, 500))) x), '[]'::jsonb),
    'recent', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', l.id, 'merchant', jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name),
        'credit_type', l.credit_type, 'kind', l.kind, 'amount', l.amount, 'balance_after', l.balance_after, 'reason', l.reason,
        'actor', case l.actor_kind when 'PLATFORM' then (select coalesce(nullif(s.full_name, ''), s.email) from public.platform_staff s where s.user_id = l.actor_id)
                                   when 'MERCHANT' then 'merchant' else 'system' end,
        'created_at', l.created_at) order by l.id desc)
      from (select * from public.credit_ledger where merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and (p_type is null or credit_type = p_type)
            order by id desc limit 50) l join public.merchants m on m.id = l.merchant_id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'packages', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(k) order by k.status, k.credit_type, k.sort_order, k.price) from public.credit_packages k), '[]'::jsonb),
    'settings', coalesce((select value from public.platform_settings where key = 'credits'), '{}'::jsonb));
end;

platform_data_overview.src:
begin

    'database', jsonb_build_object('size', pg_size_pretty(pg_database_size(current_database())), 'tables', public._platform_table_counts(), 'at', now()),

      'last_run', (select value from public.platform_settings where key = 'retention_state'),

        'system_logs', (select count(*) from public.system_logs where resolved_at is not null
          and resolved_at < now() - make_interval(days => coalesce((select (value ->> 'system_logs_days')::int from public.platform_settings where key = 'retention'), 90))),
        'notifications', (select count(*) from public.platform_notifications where read_at is not null
          and read_at < now() - make_interval(days => coalesce((select (value ->> 'notifications_days')::int from public.platform_settings where key = 'retention'), 90))))),
    'exports', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', e.id, 'kind', e.kind, 'actor', e.actor_email, 'reason', e.reason, 'detail', e.detail, 'created_at', e.created_at,
        'merchant', (select jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name) from public.merchants m where m.id = e.merchant_id)) order by e.id desc), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (select * from public.platform_data_exports where merchant_id is null or merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) order by id desc limit 50) e),
    'deletion_requests', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(public._deletion_request_json(r) order by (r.status in ('REQUESTED', 'APPROVED')) desc, r.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)

    'imports', jsonb_build_object(
      'failed_30d', (select count(*) from public.channel_order_imports i where i.status = 'FAILED' and i.updated_at > now() - interval '30 days'
        and i.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())),
      'rows', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', i.id, 'external_number', coalesce(i.external_number, i.external_id), 'error', i.error,
          'warnings', i.warnings, 'attempts', i.attempts, 'received_via', i.received_via, 'updated_at', i.updated_at,

          'merchant', jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name)) order by i.updated_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
        from (select * from public.channel_order_imports where status = 'FAILED' and updated_at > now() - interval '30 days'
                and merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) order by updated_at desc limit 100) i
        join public.sales_channels c on c.id = i.channel_id join public.merchants m on m.id = i.merchant_id)),

platform_integrations_overview.src:
declare
  v_ids uuid[];
  v_sms jsonb := coalesce((select value from public.platform_settings where key = 'sms'), '{}'::jsonb);
  v_bd jsonb := coalesce((select value from public.platform_settings where key = 'bd_courier'), '{}'::jsonb);
begin
  perform public._platform_require('integrations', 'view');
  select coalesce(array_agg(id), '{}') into v_ids from public.merchants where id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and status <> 'CLOSED';
  return jsonb_build_object(
    -- Shopify and WooCommerce stores (merchant-authorised; their credentials stay with them).
    'stores', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'merchant', jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name),
        'platform', c.platform, 'name', c.name, 'domain', c.shop_domain, 'status', c.status, 'last_sync_at', c.last_sync_at, 'last_order_at', c.last_order_at,
        'last_error', c.last_error, 'orders', c.orders_imported,
        'failed_jobs', (select count(*) from public.channel_sync_jobs j where j.channel_id = c.id and j.status = 'FAILED'),
        'overdue_jobs', (select count(*) from public.channel_sync_jobs j where j.channel_id = c.id and j.status = 'PENDING' and j.next_attempt_at < now() - interval '15 minutes'),
        'webhook_errors_24h', (select count(*) from public.system_logs l where l.merchant_id = c.merchant_id and l.category = 'WEBHOOK' and l.level = 'ERROR'
                               and l.last_seen_at > now() - interval '24 hours' and l.source ilike '%' || lower(c.platform) || '%'))
        order by (c.status = 'ERROR') desc, m.number)
      from public.sales_channels c join public.merchants m on m.id = c.merchant_id
      where c.merchant_id = any (v_ids) and c.status <> 'DISCONNECTED'), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- Courier accounts each merchant connected (Pathao, Steadfast, RedX, Carrybee…).
    'couriers', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', c.id, 'merchant', jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name),
        'name', c.name, 'provider', c.provider, 'api_enabled', c.api_enabled, 'api_status', c.api_status, 'is_active', c.is_active,
        'last_event_at', (select max(e.received_at) from public.courier_webhook_events e where e.merchant_id = c.merchant_id and e.courier_id = c.id),
        'failed_events_24h', (select count(*) from public.courier_webhook_events e where e.merchant_id = c.merchant_id and e.courier_id = c.id
                              and e.result in ('FAILED', 'UNMATCHED') and e.received_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),
        'failed_bookings_7d', (select count(*) from public.system_logs l where l.merchant_id = c.merchant_id and l.category = 'COURIER' and l.level = 'ERROR'
                               and l.last_seen_at > now() - interval '7 days'))
        order by m.number, c.name)
      from public.couriers c join public.merchants m on m.id = c.merchant_id
      where c.merchant_id = any (v_ids) and c.api_enabled), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- Payment gateways merchants use for their customers' advances (their own accounts).
    'payments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('merchant', jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name),
        'providers', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(g.key order by g.key), '[]'::jsonb) from jsonb_each(s.value -> 'providers') g
                      where (g.value ->> 'enabled')::boolean and g.value ->> 'type' = 'redirect'),
        'events_24h', (select count(*) from public.payment_events e where e.merchant_id = m.id and e.created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),
        'last_event_at', (select max(created_at) from public.payment_events e where e.merchant_id = m.id),
        'errors_24h', (select count(*) from public.system_logs l where l.merchant_id = m.id and l.category = 'PAYMENT' and l.level = 'ERROR'
                       and l.last_seen_at > now() - interval '24 hours')) order by m.number)
      from public.merchants m join public.settings s on s.merchant_id = m.id and s.key = 'payments'
      where m.id = any (v_ids) and exists (select 1 from jsonb_each(s.value -> 'providers') g where (g.value ->> 'enabled')::boolean and g.value ->> 'type' = 'redirect')), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- Ad platforms (Meta, TikTok, Google).
    'ads', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(x order by x ->> 'merchant_number') from (
        select jsonb_build_object('merchant', jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name), 'merchant_number', lpad(m.number::text, 8, '0'),
          'platform', a.platform, 'name', coalesce(a.display_name, a.external_user), 'status', a.status, 'last_error', a.last_error, 'at', a.connected_at) x
        from public.ad_connections a join public.merchants m on m.id = a.merchant_id where a.merchant_id = any (v_ids)
        union all
        select jsonb_build_object('merchant', jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name), 'merchant_number', lpad(m.number::text, 8, '0'),
          'platform', 'META', 'name', coalesce(a.meta_name, a.name),
          'status', case when a.connection_status = 'ERROR' or a.last_sync_status = 'ERROR' then 'ERROR' else a.connection_status end,
          'last_error', coalesce(a.connection_error, a.last_sync_error), 'at', a.last_sync_at)
        from public.meta_ad_accounts a join public.merchants m on m.id = a.merchant_id where a.merchant_id = any (v_ids) and a.is_active and a.token_hint is not null) y), '[]'::jsonb),
    -- The platform's own services.
    'platform', jsonb_build_object(
      'sms', jsonb_build_object('connected', coalesce((v_sms ->> 'connected')::boolean, false), 'provider', v_sms ->> 'provider',
        'balance', v_sms -> 'balance', 'balance_checked_at', v_sms -> 'balance_checked_at',
        'failed_24h', (select count(*) from public.service_usage where service = 'SMS' and status = 'FAILED' and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),
        'sent_24h', (select count(*) from public.service_usage where service = 'SMS' and status = 'SUCCEEDED' and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),
        'last_error', (select error from public.service_usage where service = 'SMS' and status = 'FAILED' order by created_at desc limit 1)),
      'bd_courier', jsonb_build_object('connected', coalesce((v_bd ->> 'connected')::boolean, false), 'service', v_bd ->> 'service',
        'last_test_at', v_bd -> 'last_test_at', 'last_test_ok', v_bd -> 'last_test_ok', 'last_error', v_bd -> 'last_error',
        'failed_24h', (select count(*) from public.service_usage where service = 'BD_COURIER' and status = 'FAILED' and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),
        'succeeded_24h', (select count(*) from public.service_usage where service = 'BD_COURIER' and status = 'SUCCEEDED' and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours')),
      'billing_gateways', coalesce((select value from public.platform_settings where key = 'billing_gateways'), '{}'::jsonb),
      'pbx', (select jsonb_build_object('last_seen_at', last_seen_at, 'online', last_seen_at > now() - interval '2 minutes', 'version', version)
              from public.pbx_gateway_status),
      'ai', jsonb_build_object('present', false, 'note', 'No AI service is connected in this application yet')),
    'can', jsonb_build_object('edit', public.platform_can('integrations', 'edit'), 'manage', public.platform_can('integrations', 'manage')));
end;

platform_merchant_credits.src:
begin
  perform public._platform_require('credits', 'view', p_merchant);
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'balances', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code', t.code, 'name', t.name, 'unit', t.unit,
        'balance', coalesce((select balance from public.credit_balances b where b.merchant_id = p_merchant and b.credit_type = t.code), 0),
        'available', public.credit_available(p_merchant, t.code),
        'expiring_30d', (select coalesce(sum(remaining), 0) from public.credit_lots where merchant_id = p_merchant and credit_type = t.code
                         and remaining > 0 and expires_at > now() and expires_at <= now() + interval '30 days'))
      order by t.sort_order) from public.credit_types t), '[]'::jsonb),
    'lots', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', l.id, 'credit_type', l.credit_type, 'granted', l.granted, 'remaining', l.remaining,
        'expires_at', l.expires_at, 'created_at', l.created_at, 'kind', e.kind, 'reason', e.reason) order by l.expires_at nulls last, l.id)
      from public.credit_lots l join public.credit_ledger e on e.id = l.entry_id where l.merchant_id = p_merchant and l.remaining > 0), '[]'::jsonb),
    'ledger', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', l.id, 'credit_type', l.credit_type, 'kind', l.kind, 'amount', l.amount,
        'balance_after', l.balance_after, 'reason', l.reason, 'reference_type', l.reference_type, 'reference_id', l.reference_id,
        'expires_at', l.expires_at, 'metadata', l.metadata,
        'actor', case l.actor_kind when 'PLATFORM' then (select coalesce(nullif(s.full_name, ''), s.email) from public.platform_staff s where s.user_id = l.actor_id)
                                   when 'MERCHANT' then 'merchant' else 'system' end,
        'created_at', l.created_at) order by l.id desc)
      from (select * from public.credit_ledger where merchant_id = p_merchant order by id desc limit 100) l), '[]'::jsonb),
    'usage', jsonb_build_object('sms', public._usage_state(p_merchant, 'SMS'), 'bd_courier', public._usage_state(p_merchant, 'BD_COURIER')),
    'overrides', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o)) from public.merchant_service_overrides o where o.merchant_id = p_merchant), '[]'::jsonb));
end;

platform_merchants_list.src:
declare
  v_q text := nullif(trim(coalesce(p_filters ->> 'q', '')), '');
  v_status text := nullif(p_filters ->> 'status', '');
  v_manager uuid := nullif(p_filters ->> 'manager_id', '')::uuid;
  v_store text := nullif(p_filters ->> 'store', '');
  v_demo text := nullif(p_filters ->> 'demo', '');
  v_result jsonb;
begin
  perform public._platform_require('merchants', 'view');
  with base as (
    select m.*,
      (select count(*) from public.sales_channels c where c.merchant_id = m.id and c.status <> 'DISCONNECTED') as stores,
      (select string_agg(distinct c.platform, ',') from public.sales_channels c where c.merchant_id = m.id and c.status <> 'DISCONNECTED') as store_platforms,
      (select count(*) from public.orders o where o.merchant_id = m.id) as orders_total,
      (select count(*) from public.orders o where o.merchant_id = m.id and o.created_at > now() - interval '30 days') as orders_30d,
      (select max(o.created_at) from public.orders o where o.merchant_id = m.id) as last_order_at,
      (select count(*) from public.profiles p where p.merchant_id = m.id and p.is_active) as staff,
      (select coalesce(nullif(s.full_name, ''), s.email) from public.platform_staff s where s.user_id = m.account_manager_id) as manager_name
    from public.merchants m
    where m.id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and m.deleted_at is null
      and (v_status is null or m.status = v_status)
      and (v_manager is null or m.account_manager_id = v_manager)
      and (v_demo is null or m.is_demo = (v_demo = 'true'))
      and (v_q is null or m.name ilike '%' || v_q || '%' or m.slug ilike '%' || v_q || '%' or m.owner_email ilike '%' || v_q || '%'
           or m.phone ilike '%' || v_q || '%' or m.number::text = v_q)
  ), filtered as (
    select * from base
    where v_store is null or (v_store = 'none' and stores = 0) or (v_store <> 'none' and store_platforms ilike '%' || v_store || '%')
  )
  select jsonb_build_object(
    'total', (select count(*) from filtered),
    'items', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'id', f.id, 'number', f.number, 'name', f.name, 'slug', f.slug, 'status', f.status, 'status_reason', f.status_reason,
        'is_demo', f.is_demo, 'owner_email', f.owner_email, 'phone', f.phone, 'created_at', f.created_at, 'onboarded_at', f.onboarded_at,
        'account_manager', case when f.account_manager_id is null then null else jsonb_build_object('id', f.account_manager_id, 'name', f.manager_name) end,
        'stores', f.stores, 'store_platforms', coalesce(string_to_array(f.store_platforms, ','), '{}'),
        'orders_total', f.orders_total, 'orders_30d', f.orders_30d, 'last_order_at', f.last_order_at, 'staff', f.staff,
        'onboarding', public._merchant_onboarding(f.id)))
      from (select * from filtered
            order by
              case when p_direction = 'asc' then case p_sort when 'name' then lower(name) when 'status' then status else null end end asc,
              case when p_direction <> 'asc' then case p_sort when 'name' then lower(name) when 'status' then status else null end end desc,
              case when p_direction = 'asc' then case p_sort when 'orders' then orders_30d when 'number' then number else null end end asc,
              case when p_direction <> 'asc' then case p_sort when 'orders' then orders_30d when 'number' then number else null end end desc,
              case when p_direction = 'asc' then case p_sort when 'last_order' then last_order_at when 'created_at' then created_at else null end end asc nulls first,
              case when p_direction <> 'asc' then case p_sort when 'last_order' then last_order_at when 'created_at' then created_at else null end end desc nulls last,
              number desc
            limit greatest(1, least(p_limit, 200)) offset greatest(0, p_offset)) f), '[]'::jsonb),
    'counts', (select jsonb_object_agg(status, n) from (select status, count(*) n from public.merchants
                where id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and deleted_at is null group by status) c))
  into v_result;
  return v_result;
end;

platform_order_fee_overview.src:
begin
  perform public._platform_require('credits', 'view');
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'settings', coalesce((select value from public.platform_settings where key = 'order_fee'), '{}'::jsonb),
    'plans', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code', code, 'name', name) order by sort_order, code) from public.plans), '[]'::jsonb),
    'totals', (select jsonb_build_object(
        'month_charged_tk', coalesce(sum(fee) filter (where charge = 'CHARGED' and created_at >= date_trunc('month', now())), 0),

      select jsonb_build_object('merchant_id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name, 'status', m.status)
        || public._order_fee_state(m.id) as x
      from public.merchants m
      where public.platform_can('credits', 'view', m.id)
        and (coalesce(trim(p_q), '') = '' or m.name ilike '%' || trim(p_q) || '%' or m.number::text = trim(p_q))
