platform_overview.src:
declare
  v_from timestamptz := p_from::timestamptz;
  v_to timestamptz := (p_to + 1)::timestamptz;
begin
  perform public._platform_require('overview', 'view');
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'range', jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to),
    'merchants', jsonb_build_object(
      'total', (select count(*) from public.merchants where id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and deleted_at is null and not is_demo),
      'demo', (select count(*) from public.merchants where id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and deleted_at is null and is_demo),
      'by_status', (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(status, n), '{}'::jsonb) from (select status, count(*) n from public.merchants
                    where id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and deleted_at is null and not is_demo group by status) s),
      'new', (select count(*) from public.merchants where id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and deleted_at is null and not is_demo
              and created_at >= v_from and created_at < v_to),
      'onboarded', (select count(*) from public.merchants where id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and deleted_at is null and not is_demo
                    and onboarded_at >= v_from and onboarded_at < v_to),
      -- Placed no order in the last 30 days though they have before: worth a look, not a confirmed churn.
      'quiet_30d', (select count(*) from public.merchants m where m.id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and m.deleted_at is null and not m.is_demo
                    and m.status = 'ACTIVE' and exists (select 1 from public.orders o where o.merchant_id = m.id)
                    and not exists (select 1 from public.orders o where o.merchant_id = m.id and o.created_at > now() - interval '30 days'))),
    'stores', (select coalesce(jsonb_object_agg(platform, jsonb_build_object('connected', connected, 'error', errored)), '{}'::jsonb)
               from (select platform, count(*) filter (where status = 'CONNECTED') connected, count(*) filter (where status = 'ERROR') errored
                     from public.sales_channels where merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) group by platform) s),
    'orders', (select jsonb_build_object('count', count(*), 'value', coalesce(sum(total_amount) filter (where status not in ('CANCELLED', 'REJECTED_FRAUD')), 0))
               from public.orders where merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and created_at >= v_from and created_at < v_to),
    'sms', (select jsonb_build_object('sent', count(*) filter (where status = 'SENT'), 'failed', count(*) filter (where status = 'FAILED'),
                                      'queued', count(*) filter (where status = 'QUEUED'), 'segments', coalesce(sum(segments) filter (where status = 'SENT'), 0))
            from public.notification_logs where channel = 'SMS' and merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())
              and created_at >= v_from and created_at < v_to),
    'courier', jsonb_build_object(
      'history_checks', (select count(*) from public.fraud_checks where merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())
                         and 'courier_history' = any (providers) and created_at >= v_from and created_at < v_to),
      'accounts_connected', (select count(*) from public.couriers where merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and api_enabled),
      'bookings', (select count(*) from public.shipments where merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())
                   and created_at >= v_from and created_at < v_to and consignment_id is not null),
      'webhook_failures', (select count(*) from public.courier_webhook_events where merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())
                           and result = 'FAILED' and received_at >= v_from and received_at < v_to)),
    'integrations', jsonb_build_object(
      'errors', (select count(*) from public.system_logs where level = 'ERROR' and last_seen_at >= v_from and last_seen_at < v_to
                 and (merchant_id is null or merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()))),
      'webhook_errors', (select count(*) from public.system_logs where level in ('ERROR', 'WARN') and category = 'WEBHOOK'
                         and last_seen_at >= v_from and last_seen_at < v_to
                         and (merchant_id is null or merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()))),
      'failed_jobs', (select count(*) from public.channel_sync_jobs where status = 'FAILED' and updated_at >= v_from and updated_at < v_to
                      and merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()))),
    'support', jsonb_build_object(
      'open', (select count(*) from public.support_tickets where status not in ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')
               and merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()))),
    'pbx', (select jsonb_build_object('gateway_seen_at', max(last_seen_at), 'businesses', (select count(*) from public.pbx_businesses where pbx_enabled))
            from public.pbx_gateway_status),
    'series', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('day', d::date,
        'orders', (select count(*) from public.orders o where o.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())
                   and o.created_at >= d and o.created_at < d + interval '1 day'),
        'merchants', (select count(*) from public.merchants m where m.id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and m.deleted_at is null and not m.is_demo
                      and m.created_at >= d and m.created_at < d + interval '1 day')) order by d), '[]'::jsonb)
               from generate_series(v_from, v_to - interval '1 day', interval '1 day') d),
    'approvals_pending', (select count(*) from public.platform_approvals where status = 'PENDING' and expires_at > now())
  );
end;

platform_overview_business.src:
declare
  v_from timestamptz := (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Dhaka');
  v_to timestamptz := ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Dhaka');
  v_real uuid[];
  v_billing boolean := public.platform_can('subscriptions', 'view');
  v_cost numeric := nullif((select (value ->> 'cost_per_segment')::numeric from public.platform_settings where key = 'sms'), 0);
  v_bd_cost numeric := (select (value ->> 'bd_courier_per_lookup')::numeric from public.platform_settings where key = 'cost_assumptions');
begin
  perform public._platform_require('overview', 'view');
  select coalesce(array_agg(id), '{}') into v_real from public.merchants where not is_demo and id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids());
  return jsonb_build_object(
    -- Billing figures only for employees allowed to see billing.
    'billing', case when v_billing then (select jsonb_build_object(
        'mrr', coalesce(sum(case s.billing_interval when 'YEAR' then s.price / 12 else s.price end) filter (where s.status in ('ACTIVE', 'PAST_DUE')), 0),
        'active', count(*) filter (where s.status = 'ACTIVE'),
        'trialing', count(*) filter (where s.status = 'TRIALING'),
        'past_due', count(*) filter (where s.status = 'PAST_DUE'),
        'paused', count(*) filter (where s.status = 'PAUSED'),
        'trials_ending_7d', count(*) filter (where s.status = 'TRIALING' and s.trial_ends_at < now() + interval '7 days'),
        'cancelling', count(*) filter (where s.cancel_at_period_end),
        'cancelled_in_range', (select count(*) from public.subscriptions x where x.merchant_id = any (v_real) and x.status in ('CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')
                               and x.ended_at >= v_from and x.ended_at < v_to),
        'revenue_in_range', (select coalesce(sum(p.amount), 0) from public.billing_payments p where p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' and p.merchant_id = any (v_real)
                             and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) >= v_from and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) < v_to)
                          + (select coalesce(sum(t.amount_tk), 0) from public.pbx_bkash_transactions t where t.status = 'COMPLETED' and t.merchant_id = any (v_real)
                             and t.completed_at >= v_from and t.completed_at < v_to),
        'subscription_revenue_in_range', (select coalesce(sum(p.amount), 0) from public.billing_payments p join public.billing_invoices i on i.id = p.invoice_id
                             where p.status = 'SUCCEEDED' and i.kind = 'SUBSCRIPTION' and p.merchant_id = any (v_real)
                               and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) >= v_from and coalesce(p.verified_at, p.created_at) < v_to),
        'overdue_invoices', (select count(*) from public.billing_invoices i where i.status = 'OPEN' and i.due_at < now() and i.merchant_id = any (v_real)),
        'failed_payments', (select count(*) from public.billing_payments p where p.status in ('FAILED', 'REJECTED') and p.merchant_id = any (v_real)
                            and p.created_at >= v_from and p.created_at < v_to))
      from public.subscriptions s where s.ended_at is null and s.merchant_id = any (v_real)) end,
    'credits', jsonb_build_object(
      'sms_outstanding', (select coalesce(sum(balance), 0) from public.credit_balances where credit_type = 'SMS' and merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())),
      'courier_outstanding', (select coalesce(sum(balance), 0) from public.credit_balances where credit_type = 'COURIER' and merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()))),
    'metered', (select jsonb_build_object(
        'sms_units', coalesce(sum(units) filter (where service = 'SMS' and status = 'SUCCEEDED' and refunded_at is null), 0),
        'sms_free_units', coalesce(sum(units) filter (where service = 'SMS' and status = 'SUCCEEDED' and refunded_at is null and charge = 'FREE'), 0),
        'bd_lookups', count(*) filter (where service = 'BD_COURIER' and status = 'SUCCEEDED'),
        'bd_failed', count(*) filter (where service = 'BD_COURIER' and status = 'FAILED'),
        'bd_refused', count(*) filter (where service = 'BD_COURIER' and status = 'DENIED'),
        'provider_cost_reported', coalesce(sum(provider_cost), 0),
        'provider_cost_estimated', case
          when v_cost is null and coalesce(sum(units) filter (where service = 'SMS' and status = 'SUCCEEDED' and provider_cost is null), 0) > 0 then null
          when v_bd_cost is null and count(*) filter (where service = 'BD_COURIER' and status = 'SUCCEEDED') > 0 then null
          else coalesce(sum(units) filter (where service = 'SMS' and status = 'SUCCEEDED' and provider_cost is null), 0) * coalesce(v_cost, 0)
             + count(*) filter (where service = 'BD_COURIER' and status = 'SUCCEEDED') * coalesce(v_bd_cost, 0) end)
      from public.service_usage where merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and created_at >= v_from and created_at < v_to),
    'services', jsonb_build_object('sms_connected', public._platform_service_connected('SMS'), 'bd_courier_connected', public._platform_service_connected('BD_COURIER')),
    'support', jsonb_build_object(
      'open', (select count(*) from public.support_tickets where status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())),
      'overdue', (select count(*) from public.support_tickets where status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and due_at < now() and merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())),
      'urgent', (select count(*) from public.support_tickets where status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and priority = 'URGENT' and merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()))),
    'growth', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('month', mo::date,
        'new', (select count(*) from public.merchants where id = any (v_real) and created_at >= mo and created_at < mo + interval '1 month'),
        'churned', (select count(*) from public.subscriptions s where s.merchant_id = any (v_real) and s.price > 0 and s.status in ('CANCELLED', 'EXPIRED')
                    and s.ended_at >= mo and s.ended_at < mo + interval '1 month'),
        'active', (select count(distinct o.merchant_id) from public.orders o where o.merchant_id = any (v_real) and o.created_at >= mo and o.created_at < mo + interval '1 month'))
        order by mo), '[]'::jsonb)
      from generate_series(date_trunc('month', now()) - interval '5 months', date_trunc('month', now()), interval '1 month') mo));
end;

platform_pbx_merchant.src:
declare
  b public.pbx_businesses := public._platform_pbx_business(p_merchant);
  v jsonb;
begin
  if not exists (select 1 from public.merchants where id = p_merchant) or not public.platform_can('pbx', 'view', p_merchant) then
    raise exception 'NOT_FOUND: merchant not found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;
  v := jsonb_build_object(
    'merchant', (select jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name, 'status', m.status) from public.merchants m where m.id = p_merchant),
    'feature', public.merchant_entitlements(p_merchant) -> 'pbx',
    'business', public._platform_pbx_business_json(b),
    'click_to_call', public._platform_pbx_click_to_call(p_merchant),
    'agents', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', a.id, 'extension', a.extension, 'sip_username', a.sip_username, 'active', a.active,
        'inbound_enabled', a.inbound_enabled, 'ring_group_id', a.ring_group_id, 'profile_id', a.profile_id,
        'name', coalesce(nullif(trim(p.full_name), ''), p.email), 'online', exists (select 1 from public.pbx_presence pr where pr.agent_id = a.id))
        order by a.extension) from public.pbx_agents a join public.profiles p on p.id = a.profile_id where a.business_id = b.id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'ring_groups', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', g.id, 'name', g.name, 'strategy', g.strategy, 'ring_seconds', g.ring_seconds,
        'is_default', g.is_default, 'active', g.active) order by g.is_default desc, g.name) from public.pbx_ring_groups g where g.business_id = b.id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'staff', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', p.id, 'name', coalesce(nullif(trim(p.full_name), ''), p.email), 'email', p.email)
        order by p.full_name) from public.profiles p where p.merchant_id = p_merchant and p.is_active), '[]'::jsonb),
    'subscriptions', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', s.id, 'package', pk.name, 'agents', s.agents, 'channels', s.channels,
        'months', s.months, 'amount_tk', s.amount_tk, 'starts_at', s.starts_at, 'expires_at', s.expires_at, 'status', s.status, 'source', s.source, 'note', s.note)
        order by s.created_at desc) from (select * from public.pbx_subscriptions where business_id = b.id order by created_at desc limit 10) s
        join public.pbx_packages pk on pk.id = s.package_id), '[]'::jsonb),
    'ledger', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', l.id, 'kind', l.kind, 'amount_tk', l.amount_tk, 'balance_after_tk', l.balance_after_tk,
        'note', l.note, 'created_at', l.created_at) order by l.created_at desc)
        from (select * from public.pbx_ledger where business_id = b.id order by created_at desc limit 20) l), '[]'::jsonb),
    'payments', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('reference', t.reference, 'type', t.type, 'amount_tk', t.amount_tk, 'status', t.status,
        'trx_id', t.trx_id, 'created_at', t.created_at, 'completed_at', t.completed_at, 'failure_reason', t.failure_reason) order by t.created_at desc)
        from (select * from public.pbx_bkash_transactions where business_id = b.id order by created_at desc limit 10) t), '[]'::jsonb),
    'calls', (select jsonb_build_object('total', count(*), 'answered', count(*) filter (where answered_at is not null),
        'missed', count(*) filter (where direction = 'INBOUND' and answered_at is null), 'minutes', round(coalesce(sum(billed_seconds), 0) / 60.0, 1),
        'charged_tk', round(coalesce(sum(charged_tk), 0), 2))
      from public.pbx_call_records where merchant_id = p_merchant and requested_at > now() - interval '30 days'),
    'history', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('action', l.action, 'actor', l.actor_email, 'reason', l.reason, 'result', l.result, 'created_at', l.created_at)
        order by l.created_at desc) from (select * from public.platform_audit_logs where merchant_id = p_merchant and action like 'pbx.%'
        order by created_at desc limit 20) l), '[]'::jsonb),
    'can', jsonb_build_object('edit', public.platform_can('pbx', 'edit', p_merchant), 'manage', public.platform_can('pbx', 'manage', p_merchant)));
  return v;
end;

platform_pbx_overview.src:
declare
  v_rows jsonb := '[]'::jsonb;
  m record;
begin
  perform public._platform_require('pbx', 'view');
  for m in
    select mm.id, mm.number, mm.name, mm.status, mm.is_demo from public.merchants mm
    where mm.id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and mm.status <> 'CLOSED' order by mm.number
  loop
    v_rows := v_rows || jsonb_build_object('merchant', jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name, 'status', m.status, 'is_demo', m.is_demo),
      'feature', public.merchant_entitlements(m.id) -> 'pbx',
      'business', public._platform_pbx_business_json(public._platform_pbx_business(m.id)),
      'calls_7d', (select count(*) from public.pbx_call_records c where c.merchant_id = m.id and c.requested_at > now() - interval '7 days'),
      'last_call_at', (select max(requested_at) from public.pbx_call_records c where c.merchant_id = m.id),
      'click_to_call', public._platform_pbx_click_to_call(m.id));
  end loop;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'merchants', v_rows,
    'gateway', (select jsonb_build_object('last_seen_at', last_seen_at, 'version', version, 'online', last_seen_at > now() - interval '2 minutes',
        'softphones_online', detail -> 'softphonesOnline', 'active_calls', detail -> 'activeCalls', 'trunk_sync', detail -> 'trunkSync',
        'trunks', detail -> 'trunks') from public.pbx_gateway_status),
    'settings', public._vd_cfg(),
    'secrets', jsonb_build_object(
      'gateway_token', (select jsonb_build_object('hint', hint, 'at', updated_at) from public.platform_credentials where key = 'voicedrive.gateway'),
      'turn_secret', (select jsonb_build_object('hint', hint, 'at', updated_at) from public.platform_credentials where key = 'voicedrive.turn')),
    'packages', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(p) order by p.sort) from public.pbx_packages p), '[]'::jsonb),
    'can', jsonb_build_object('edit', public.platform_can('pbx', 'edit'), 'manage', public.platform_can('pbx', 'manage')));
end;

platform_security_overview.src:
begin
  perform public._platform_require('security', 'view');
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'settings', coalesce((select value from public.platform_settings where key = 'security'), '{}'::jsonb),
    'staff', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object(
        'user_id', s.user_id, 'email', s.email, 'name', coalesce(nullif(trim(s.full_name), ''), s.email), 'active', s.is_active,
        'role', jsonb_build_object('code', r.code, 'name', r.name, 'is_super', r.is_super),
        'scope', case when r.is_super then 'ALL' else s.merchant_scope end,
        'privileged', r.is_super or exists (select 1 from public.platform_role_permissions rp where rp.role_id = r.id
          and (rp.module, rp.action) in (('employees', 'manage'), ('security', 'manage'), ('data', 'manage'), ('credits', 'manage'), ('settings', 'manage'))),
        'last_sign_in_at', u.last_sign_in_at, 'last_seen_at', s.last_seen_at,
        'sessions', (select count(*) from auth.sessions x where x.user_id = s.user_id and (x.not_after is null or x.not_after > now())),
        'oldest_session_at', (select min(x.created_at) from auth.sessions x where x.user_id = s.user_id and (x.not_after is null or x.not_after > now())),
        'second_factors', (select count(*) from auth.mfa_factors f where f.user_id = s.user_id and f.status = 'verified'),
        'last_action_at', (select max(a.created_at) from public.platform_audit_logs a where a.actor_id = s.user_id),
        'denied_7d', (select count(*) from public.platform_audit_logs a where a.actor_id = s.user_id and a.result = 'DENIED' and a.created_at > now() - interval '7 days'))
        order by r.is_super desc, s.is_active desc, s.email), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.platform_staff s join public.platform_roles r on r.id = s.role_id left join auth.users u on u.id = s.user_id),
    'credentials', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('key', c.key, 'hint', c.hint, 'updated_at', c.updated_at,
        'age_days', extract(day from now() - c.updated_at)::int,
        'updated_by', (select coalesce(nullif(trim(p.full_name), ''), p.email) from public.platform_staff p where p.user_id = c.updated_by)) order by c.key), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.platform_credentials c),
    'counts', jsonb_build_object(
      'denied_24h', (select count(*) from public.platform_audit_logs where result = 'DENIED' and created_at > now() - interval '24 hours'),
      'pending_approvals', (select count(*) from public.platform_approvals where status = 'PENDING' and expires_at > now()),
      'support_sessions_open', (select count(*) from public.support_sessions where ended_at is null and expires_at > now())),
    'sensitive', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', a.id, 'action', a.action, 'actor', a.actor_email, 'reason', a.reason,
        'result', a.result, 'created_at', a.created_at,
        'merchant', (select jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name) from public.merchants m where m.id = a.merchant_id))
        order by a.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (select * from public.platform_audit_logs
            where action ~ '^(employees\.|roles?\.|settings\.|security\.|data\.|credits\.adjust|sms\.(connect|disconnect)|bd_courier\.(connect|disconnect)|billing\.gateway|pbx\.(trunk|turn|gateway)|support\.session)'
            order by created_at desc limit 30) a),
    'can', jsonb_build_object('manage', public.platform_can('security', 'manage')));
end;

platform_service_status.src:
declare
  v_key text := case p_service when 'SMS' then 'sms' else 'bd_courier' end;
  v jsonb := coalesce((select value from public.platform_settings where key = v_key), '{}'::jsonb);
begin
  perform public._platform_require(public._usage_module(p_service), 'view');
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'config', v,
    'credential', (select jsonb_build_object('hint', c.hint, 'updated_at', c.updated_at,
        'updated_by', (select coalesce(nullif(s.full_name, ''), s.email) from public.platform_staff s where s.user_id = c.updated_by))
      from public.platform_credentials c where c.key = case p_service when 'SMS' then 'sms.' || coalesce(v ->> 'provider', '') else 'bd_courier' end and c.hint is not null),
    'policy', public._usage_policy(p_service),
    'feature', (select to_jsonb(f) from public.features f where f.code = public._usage_feature(p_service)),
    'plans', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('code', code, 'name', name, 'includes', coalesce((features ->> public._usage_feature(p_service))::boolean, false))
      order by sort_order) from public.plans where status = 'ACTIVE'), '[]'::jsonb),
    'overrides', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(o) || jsonb_build_object('merchant', jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name)) order by m.number)
      from public.merchant_service_overrides o join public.merchants m on m.id = o.merchant_id
      where o.service = p_service and o.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())), '[]'::jsonb),
    'exceptions', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('merchant', jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name),
        'enabled', mf.enabled, 'reason', mf.reason, 'expires_at', mf.expires_at) order by m.number)
      from public.merchant_features mf join public.merchants m on m.id = mf.merchant_id
      where mf.feature_code = public._usage_feature(p_service) and mf.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())), '[]'::jsonb),
    'can', jsonb_build_object('edit', public.platform_can(public._usage_module(p_service), 'edit'),
                              'manage', public.platform_can(public._usage_module(p_service), 'manage')));
end;

platform_ticket_get.src:
declare
  t public.support_tickets;
begin
  select * into t from public.support_tickets where id = p_id;
  if t.id is null or not public.platform_can('support', 'view', t.merchant_id) then
    raise exception 'NOT_FOUND: ticket not found' using errcode = 'P0002';
  end if;
  return public._platform_ticket_json(t) || jsonb_build_object(
    'body', t.body, 'rating', t.rating, 'context', t.context,
    'merchant_detail', (select jsonb_build_object('id', m.id, 'number', m.number, 'name', m.name, 'status', m.status, 'owner_email', m.owner_email,
        'phone', m.phone, 'is_demo', m.is_demo, 'access_mode', public.merchant_access_mode(m.id),
        'plan', (select jsonb_build_object('code', pl.code, 'name', pl.name, 'status', s.status) from public.subscriptions s
                 join public.plans pl on pl.id = s.plan_id where s.merchant_id = m.id and s.ended_at is null order by s.created_at desc limit 1),
        'account_manager', (select coalesce(nullif(trim(ps.full_name), ''), ps.email) from public.platform_staff ps where ps.user_id = m.account_manager_id))
      from public.merchants m where m.id = t.merchant_id),
    'messages', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', msg.id, 'body', msg.body, 'created_at', msg.created_at,
        'from', case when msg.platform_author is null then 'MERCHANT' else 'PLATFORM' end,
        'author', coalesce((select coalesce(nullif(trim(p.full_name), ''), p.email) from public.profiles p where p.id = msg.author_id),
                           (select coalesce(nullif(trim(s.full_name), ''), s.email) from public.platform_staff s where s.user_id = msg.platform_author)),
        'label', msg.author_label) order by msg.created_at), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.support_ticket_messages msg where msg.ticket_id = t.id),
    'events', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', e.id, 'kind', e.kind, 'body', e.body, 'data', e.data, 'actor', e.actor_email,
        'created_at', e.created_at) order by e.id), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.support_ticket_events e where e.ticket_id = t.id),
    -- Recent problems on the merchant's account, for context.
    'logs', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', l.id, 'level', l.level, 'category', l.category, 'source', l.source, 'message', l.message,
        'occurrences', l.occurrences, 'last_seen_at', l.last_seen_at, 'resolved', l.resolved_at is not null) order by l.last_seen_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (select * from public.system_logs l where l.merchant_id = t.merchant_id and l.level in ('ERROR', 'WARN')
              and l.last_seen_at > least(t.created_at, now()) - interval '7 days'
            order by l.last_seen_at desc limit 20) l),
    'sessions', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(public._platform_session_json(s) order by s.started_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
      from (select * from public.support_sessions s where s.merchant_id = t.merchant_id
              and (s.ticket_id = t.id or s.started_at > t.created_at - interval '1 day') order by s.started_at desc limit 10) s),
    'other_open', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', o.id, 'number', o.number, 'subject', o.subject, 'status', o.status,
        'priority', o.priority, 'created_at', o.created_at) order by o.created_at desc), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.support_tickets o where o.merchant_id = t.merchant_id and o.id <> t.id and o.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS')),
    -- People this ticket can be given to.
    'assignable', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('user_id', s.user_id, 'name', coalesce(nullif(trim(s.full_name), ''), s.email),
        'email', s.email) order by coalesce(nullif(trim(s.full_name), ''), s.email)), '[]'::jsonb)
      from public.platform_staff s where s.is_active and public._platform_staff_can(s.user_id, 'support', 'edit', t.merchant_id)),
    'can', jsonb_build_object('edit', public.platform_can('support', 'edit', t.merchant_id), 'manage', public.platform_can('support', 'manage', t.merchant_id),
                              'view_as', public.platform_can('support', 'edit', t.merchant_id) and
                                         (select status <> 'CLOSED' from public.merchants where id = t.merchant_id)));
end;

platform_tickets_list.src:
declare
  v_view text := coalesce(nullif(p ->> 'view', ''), 'active');
  v_q text := nullif(trim(coalesce(p ->> 'q', '')), '');
  v_merchant uuid := nullif(p ->> 'merchant', '')::uuid;
  v_priority text := nullif(upper(coalesce(p ->> 'priority', '')), '');
  v_assigned uuid := nullif(p ->> 'assigned', '')::uuid;
  v_total int;
  v_rows jsonb;
begin
  perform public._platform_require('support', 'view', v_merchant);
  if v_view not in ('active', 'mine', 'unassigned', 'overdue', 'waiting', 'escalated', 'resolved', 'all') then
    raise exception 'VALIDATION: unknown view' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  with f as (
    select t.* from public.support_tickets t
    where t.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())
      and (v_merchant is null or t.merchant_id = v_merchant)
      and (v_priority is null or t.priority = v_priority)
      and (v_assigned is null or t.assigned_to = v_assigned)
      and (v_q is null or t.subject ilike '%' || v_q || '%' or t.number::text = ltrim(v_q, '#')
           or exists (select 1 from public.merchants m where m.id = t.merchant_id and m.name ilike '%' || v_q || '%'))
      and case v_view
        when 'active' then t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS')
        when 'mine' then t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and t.assigned_to = auth.uid()
        when 'unassigned' then t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and t.assigned_to is null
        when 'overdue' then t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and t.due_at < now()
        when 'waiting' then t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and coalesce(t.last_reply_from, 'MERCHANT') = 'MERCHANT'
        when 'escalated' then t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and t.escalation_level > 0
        when 'resolved' then t.status in ('RESOLVED', 'CLOSED')
        else true end),
  page as (
    -- Overdue first, then by priority, then the most pressing due time.
    select f.*, row_number() over (order by
        case when v_view = 'resolved' then 0 else (f.due_at < now())::int end desc,
        case f.priority when 'URGENT' then 0 when 'HIGH' then 1 when 'NORMAL' then 2 else 3 end,
        case when v_view = 'resolved' then f.resolved_at end desc nulls last,
        f.due_at nulls last, f.created_at desc) as rn
    from f)
  select (select count(*) from f),
         (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(public._platform_ticket_json(t) order by pg.rn), '[]'::jsonb)
          from (select id, rn from page where rn > greatest(coalesce(p_offset, 0), 0)
                order by rn limit least(greatest(coalesce(p_limit, 50), 1), 200)) pg
          join public.support_tickets t on t.id = pg.id)
    into v_total, v_rows;
  return jsonb_build_object(
    'total', v_total,
    'rows', v_rows,
    'summary', (select jsonb_build_object(
        'active', count(*) filter (where t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS')),
        'mine', count(*) filter (where t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and t.assigned_to = auth.uid()),
        'unassigned', count(*) filter (where t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and t.assigned_to is null),
        'overdue', count(*) filter (where t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and t.due_at < now()),
        'waiting', count(*) filter (where t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and coalesce(t.last_reply_from, 'MERCHANT') = 'MERCHANT'),
        'escalated', count(*) filter (where t.status in ('OPEN', 'IN_PROGRESS') and t.escalation_level > 0),
        'resolved_7d', count(*) filter (where t.resolved_at > now() - interval '7 days'),
        -- Hours from opening to resolution, tickets resolved in the last 30 days.
        'avg_resolution_hours_30d', round((avg(extract(epoch from t.resolved_at - t.created_at) / 3600)
                                    filter (where t.resolved_at > now() - interval '30 days'))::numeric, 1),
        'avg_first_response_hours_30d', round((avg(extract(epoch from t.first_response_at - t.created_at) / 3600)
                                        filter (where t.first_response_at > now() - interval '30 days'))::numeric, 1),
        'resolved_on_time_30d', count(*) filter (where t.resolved_at > now() - interval '30 days' and (t.due_at is null or t.resolved_at <= t.due_at)),
        'resolved_30d', count(*) filter (where t.resolved_at > now() - interval '30 days'))
      from public.support_tickets t
      where t.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and (v_merchant is null or t.merchant_id = v_merchant)),
    'settings', public._platform_support_settings(),
    'can', jsonb_build_object('create', public.platform_can('support', 'create', v_merchant), 'edit', public.platform_can('support', 'edit', v_merchant),
                              'manage', public.platform_can('support', 'manage', v_merchant)));
end;

platform_usage_overview.src:
declare
  v_from timestamptz := (p_from::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Dhaka');
  v_to timestamptz := ((p_to + 1)::timestamp at time zone 'Asia/Dhaka');
begin
  perform public._platform_require('usage', 'view');
  if p_to < p_from or p_to - p_from > 366 then
    raise exception 'VALIDATION: choose a range of up to a year' using errcode = '22023';
  end if;
  return (with u as (
      select su.* from public.service_usage su
      where su.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and su.created_at >= v_from and su.created_at < v_to),
    per as (
      select m.id, m.number, m.name, m.is_demo,
        count(*) filter (where u.service = 'SMS' and u.status <> 'DENIED') as sms_attempted,
        count(*) filter (where u.service = 'SMS' and u.status = 'SUCCEEDED') as sms_sent,
        count(*) filter (where u.service = 'SMS' and u.outcome = 'DELIVERED') as sms_delivered,
        count(*) filter (where u.service = 'SMS' and (u.status = 'FAILED' or u.outcome = 'UNDELIVERED')) as sms_failed,
        count(*) filter (where u.service = 'SMS' and u.status = 'DENIED') as sms_refused,
        coalesce(sum(u.units) filter (where u.service = 'SMS' and u.charge in ('CREDITS', 'PLAN') and u.status in ('RESERVED', 'SUCCEEDED') and u.refunded_at is null), 0) as sms_billable,
        coalesce(sum(u.units) filter (where u.service = 'SMS' and u.charge = 'FREE' and u.status in ('RESERVED', 'SUCCEEDED') and u.refunded_at is null), 0) as sms_free,
        coalesce(sum(u.credits) filter (where u.service = 'SMS' and u.charge = 'CREDITS' and u.refunded_at is null and u.status <> 'DENIED'), 0) as sms_credits,
        count(*) filter (where u.service = 'BD_COURIER' and u.status <> 'DENIED') as bd_attempted,
        count(*) filter (where u.service = 'BD_COURIER' and u.status = 'SUCCEEDED') as bd_succeeded,
        count(*) filter (where u.service = 'BD_COURIER' and u.status = 'FAILED') as bd_failed,
        count(*) filter (where u.service = 'BD_COURIER' and u.status = 'DENIED') as bd_refused,
        count(*) filter (where u.service = 'BD_COURIER' and u.charge in ('CREDITS', 'PLAN') and u.status = 'SUCCEEDED') as bd_billable,
        coalesce(sum(u.credits) filter (where u.service = 'BD_COURIER' and u.charge = 'CREDITS' and u.refunded_at is null and u.status <> 'DENIED'), 0) as bd_credits
      from public.merchants m left join u on u.merchant_id = m.id
      where m.id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids()) and m.status <> 'CLOSED'
      group by m.id, m.number, m.name, m.is_demo)
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'range', jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to),
      'totals', (select jsonb_build_object(
          'sms_attempted', sum(sms_attempted), 'sms_sent', sum(sms_sent), 'sms_delivered', sum(sms_delivered), 'sms_failed', sum(sms_failed),
          'sms_refused', sum(sms_refused), 'sms_billable', sum(sms_billable), 'sms_free', sum(sms_free), 'sms_credits', sum(sms_credits),
          'bd_attempted', sum(bd_attempted), 'bd_succeeded', sum(bd_succeeded), 'bd_failed', sum(bd_failed), 'bd_refused', sum(bd_refused),
          'bd_billable', sum(bd_billable), 'bd_credits', sum(bd_credits),
          'sms_credits_outstanding', (select coalesce(sum(balance), 0) from public.credit_balances where credit_type = 'SMS'
                                      and merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())),
          'courier_credits_outstanding', (select coalesce(sum(balance), 0) from public.credit_balances where credit_type = 'COURIER'
                                          and merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())))
        from per),
      'merchants', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(per) || jsonb_build_object(
            'sms_state', (select jsonb_build_object('free_remaining', s -> 'free' -> 'remaining', 'credits', s -> 'credits_available', 'unmetered', s -> 'unmetered')
                          from public._usage_state(per.id, 'SMS') s),
            'bd_state', (select jsonb_build_object('free_remaining', s -> 'free' -> 'remaining', 'credits', s -> 'credits_available', 'unmetered', s -> 'unmetered',
                                                   'month_used', s -> 'month_used', 'monthly_cap', s -> 'monthly_cap')
                         from public._usage_state(per.id, 'BD_COURIER') s))
          order by (per.sms_attempted + per.bd_attempted) desc, per.number), '[]'::jsonb) from per),
      'daily', (select coalesce(jsonb_agg(d order by d.day), '[]'::jsonb) from (
          select (created_at at time zone 'Asia/Dhaka')::date as day,
                 count(*) filter (where service = 'SMS' and status = 'SUCCEEDED') as sms,
                 count(*) filter (where service = 'SMS' and (status = 'FAILED' or outcome = 'UNDELIVERED')) as sms_failed,
                 count(*) filter (where service = 'BD_COURIER' and status = 'SUCCEEDED') as bd,
                 count(*) filter (where service = 'BD_COURIER' and status = 'FAILED') as bd_failed
          from u group by 1) d)));
end;

platform_usage_report.src:
declare
  v_cost numeric := coalesce((select (value ->> 'cost_per_segment')::numeric from public.platform_settings where key = 'sms'), 0);
begin
  if not (public.platform_can(public._usage_module(p_service), 'view', p_merchant) or public.platform_can('usage', 'view', p_merchant)) then
    perform public._platform_require('usage', 'view', p_merchant);
  end if;
  return (with u as (
      select su.*, m.number, m.name from public.service_usage su join public.merchants m on m.id = su.merchant_id
      where su.service = p_service and su.merchant_id in (select public._platform_merchant_ids())
        and (p_merchant is null or su.merchant_id = p_merchant)
        and (su.created_at at time zone 'Asia/Dhaka')::date between p_from and p_to),
    agg as (
      select merchant_id, number, name,
        count(*) filter (where status <> 'DENIED') as attempted,
        count(*) filter (where status = 'DENIED') as denied,
        count(*) filter (where status = 'SUCCEEDED') as succeeded,
        count(*) filter (where status = 'FAILED') as failed,
        count(*) filter (where status = 'RESERVED') as in_progress,
        count(*) filter (where outcome = 'DELIVERED') as delivered,
        count(*) filter (where outcome = 'UNDELIVERED') as undelivered,
        coalesce(sum(units) filter (where status in ('RESERVED', 'SUCCEEDED') and refunded_at is null), 0) as units,
        coalesce(sum(units) filter (where charge = 'FREE' and status in ('RESERVED', 'SUCCEEDED') and refunded_at is null), 0) as free_units,
        coalesce(sum(units) filter (where charge = 'PLAN' and status in ('RESERVED', 'SUCCEEDED') and refunded_at is null), 0) as plan_units,
        coalesce(sum(credits) filter (where charge = 'CREDITS' and refunded_at is null), 0) as credits,
        coalesce(sum(credits) filter (where charge = 'CREDITS' and refunded_at is not null), 0) as credits_refunded,
        coalesce(sum(provider_cost), 0) as provider_cost,
        coalesce(sum(case when provider_cost is null and status in ('RESERVED', 'SUCCEEDED') then units * v_cost end), 0) as estimated_cost
      from u group by merchant_id, number, name)
    select jsonb_build_object(
      'service', p_service,
      'range', jsonb_build_object('from', p_from, 'to', p_to),
      'totals', coalesce((select jsonb_build_object('attempted', sum(attempted), 'denied', sum(denied), 'succeeded', sum(succeeded), 'failed', sum(failed),
          'in_progress', sum(in_progress), 'delivered', sum(delivered), 'undelivered', sum(undelivered), 'units', sum(units), 'free_units', sum(free_units),
          'plan_units', sum(plan_units), 'credits', sum(credits), 'credits_refunded', sum(credits_refunded), 'provider_cost', sum(provider_cost),
          'estimated_cost', sum(estimated_cost), 'merchants', count(*)) from agg), '{}'::jsonb),
      'merchants', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(to_jsonb(a) order by a.attempted desc, a.number) from agg a), '[]'::jsonb),
      'daily', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(d order by d.day) from (
          select (created_at at time zone 'Asia/Dhaka')::date as day, count(*) filter (where status <> 'DENIED') as attempted,
                 count(*) filter (where status = 'SUCCEEDED') as succeeded, count(*) filter (where status = 'FAILED') as failed,
                 count(*) filter (where status = 'DENIED') as denied
          from u group by 1) d), '[]'::jsonb),
      'denied_reasons', coalesce((select jsonb_object_agg(denied_reason, n) from (select denied_reason, count(*) as n from u where status = 'DENIED' group by 1) r), '{}'::jsonb),
      'recent', coalesce((select jsonb_agg(jsonb_build_object('id', r.id, 'merchant', jsonb_build_object('id', r.merchant_id, 'number', r.number, 'name', r.name),
          'status', r.status, 'charge', r.charge, 'units', r.units, 'credits', r.credits, 'refunded', r.refunded_at is not null, 'outcome', r.outcome,
          'reason', r.denied_reason, 'error', r.error,
          'reference', case when p_service = 'SMS' then (select public._mask_phone(n.recipient) from public.notification_logs n where n.id::text = r.reference) else r.reference end,
          'created_at', r.created_at) order by r.created_at desc)
        from (select * from u order by created_at desc limit 100) r), '[]'::jsonb)));
end;

public_signup_options.src:
